l.i: Nunc me luce procul terrificos conicit in specus: Queis ignota dies, queis tenebra perpetuæ incubat. In me sæua ruit fulminei dextera Numinis, Illi nulla quies, contiguis impetibus furit. Deformat senio ruga genas iam mihi pendulas: Non fractis vigor est ille meis qui fuit ossibus. Me felle[?] & miseris ira Dei torua doloribus Urget: ceu variis agminibus cingeret hostium: Antris me premit, & carceribus luce carentibus, Ceu quos examines Tartareū mors rapit ad Styga. Me circumpositis aggeribus seruat, & impedit Claustris effugium compedibusque arctat aheneis: Si clamo, & Dominum supplicibus si rogo palmulis Cunctas ille preces despiciet, votaque respuet. Obiectis lapidum, claudit iter molibus, exitus Omnes obstruit: & nulla mihi nunc superest via.

main_text.l: Sic sic ubique summi Me terret ira Patris: Ut, quæ ferox latebris Occulta captat ursa, Leunculúsve prædam.
Grassatur illa passim, Viasque claudit omnes: Me dissecat, lupi ceu Quum sæuiente dente

page.notes: The first word of the verse block, "felle", is printed with a long-s-like f whose crossbar is cut; I read "felle" but it is doubtful. "Tartareū" has a mark over the u that I read as a tilde/macron. The drop cap "S" is joined to "Ic" in the printed "SIc". Spacing in "quifuit" is run together in print and is written as "qui fuit". Verse lines are kept as printed with their line breaks inside each stanza paragraph.
